question: Which defence exercise involved the French carrier Charles de Gaulle in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varuna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Varuna** is the flagship bilateral naval exercise conducted between the **Indian Navy** and the **French Navy**.
 
• In **January 2025**, the **French Navy's** nuclear-powered aircraft carrier, **Charles de Gaulle**, led the French Carrier Strike Group (CSG) during the **23rd edition** of the **Varuna** exercise.
 
• The exercise took place in the **Arabian Sea**, a strategically vital part of the **Indian Ocean**, focusing on advanced maritime operations.
 
• The primary objectives of **Varuna 2025** included enhancing **interoperability**, conducting high-intensity combat maneuvers, and practicing **carrier strike group** operations, including **anti-submarine warfare** and **air defense** drills.
 
• This exercise highlights the growing defense synergy and the shared commitment of **India** and **France** toward maintaining a free, open, and inclusive **Indo-Pacific** region.
